protocol.strict_T0: 5 role folds x 3 system folds; every row predicted by model that saw neither its role nor its system
protocol.T1_transfer: T0-only training; target role entirely unseen
protocol.D_transfer: target role entirely unseen; D systems disjoint from T0
protocol.D_multifamily: T0 system-ranking + T1 matched-CF on seen roles only; D target roles unseen
